## What's new in 0.3.0

- **Mugig updates itself.** When a newer version is out, click the notice
  at the foot of the sidebar, then **Update Now**: Mugig downloads it,
  checks that it is signed by Mugig's author, puts it in place of the old
  one, and opens it, with your library, playlists, stations and settings as
  they were. Where it isn't allowed to change the folder it is in, it opens
  the release's page instead.
- **Signed downloads.** Each download now comes with a signature (the
  `.sig` files), which Mugig checks before installing an update.

Coming from 0.2.0? Install this version by hand, as below, this one last
time; from now on, Mugig does it.
